name: Liam Baker
bio:
Liam's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent tinkering with go-karts in his family's garage in Auckland. Although his driving ambitions were short-lived, his fascination with the mechanics and strategy of racing never waned. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering and landed a role at a small racing outfit, working his way up from junior mechanic to race engineer. Liam believes a data-driven approach combined with fostering a positive team environment is key to success.

He's now eager to take on the challenge of leading a team, bringing his technical expertise and innate understanding of the racing environment to the role. While he's still relatively new to the team principal position, his dedication to learning and improving, coupled with his meticulous planning style, set him apart. He is determined to prove that a newcomer can make a significant impact with the right combination of skill and drive.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Liam is of average height, with a focused and determined look.
